paper.title_en: Anisotropic Structural and Magnetic Response in Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$: Al-Sublattice Reconstruction upon Sm Substitution
paper.abstract_en: Chemical pressure plays a critical role in determining the crystal structures and physical properties of intermetallic compounds. Here, we report the synthesis, crystal structure, and physical properties of Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$, a structural analog of UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$, in which the smaller 5f uranium atoms are replaced by larger 4f samarium atoms. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a tetragonal $\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2}\times1$ superstructure with space group $P\bar{4}2_1m$, derived from a UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$-like average structure with space group $P4_2/nmc$. Comparison with UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ shows that chemical pressure from U-to-Sm substitution produces a strongly anisotropic structural response rather than a uniform expansion of the Ir-Al framework. While one Ir coordination environment undergoes only modest changes, the other exhibits substantial local rearrangement. The Al sublattice primarily accommodates these structural distortions, with selected Al sites showing positional splitting, anisotropic atomic displacement ellipsoids, and partial occupancies, resulting in an Al-rich composition of approximately Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$. Magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a direction dependence, including a broad anomaly near 50 K for selected magnetic-field orientations. However, the absence of corresponding anomalies in heat capacity, electrical resistivity, and lattice parameters suggests that this feature is more consistent with an anisotropic magnetic crossover than a bulk thermodynamic phase transition. These results highlight how chemical substitution at the f-element site can induce Al-sublattice reconstruction and modify the magnetic response within a closely related Ir-Al structural framework.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文是凝聚态材料学（金属间化合物合成、晶体结构与磁性）研究，与黑洞热力学、引力波、全息凝聚态物质、广义相对论基础等索引主题无关；第一阶段命中的“thermodynamic phase transition”与“heat capacity”仅为语义误匹配，并非黑洞热力学内容。
decision.title_zh: Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$ 中的各向异性结构与磁性响应：Sm 替代导致的 Al 亚晶格重构
decision.abstract_zh: 化学压力在决定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着关键作用。本文报道了 Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$ 的合成、晶体结构及物理性质，它是 UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶 X 射线衍射揭示了一个四方 $\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2}\times1$ 超结构，空间群为 $P\bar{4}2_1m$，它源自一个类 UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ 的平均结构，其空间群为 $P4_2/nmc$。与 UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ 的比较表明，从 U 到 Sm 的替代所产生的化学压力导致强烈的各向异性结构响应，而不是 Ir-Al 骨架的均匀膨胀。一种 Ir 配位环境仅发生适度变化，而另一种则表现出显著的局域重排。Al 亚晶格主要承受这些结构畸变，选定的 Al 位点表现出位置分裂、各向异性原子位移椭球和部分占据，从而形成约 Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$ 的富 Al 组成。磁化率测量揭示出方向依赖性，包括在选定磁场取向下约 50 K 处的宽异常。然而，热容、电阻率和晶格参数中缺乏相应的异常，表明这一特征更符合各向异性磁交叉而非体热力学相变。这些结果凸显了 f 元素位点的化学替代如何能在密切相关的 Ir-Al 结构框架内诱导 Al 亚晶格重构并改变磁性响应。
